bear_assumptions: Low-single-digit revenue growth, 28-30% gross margin, continuing cash burn and price competition; about 1.1x revenue after lower net cash and dilution.
base_assumptions: About 12-15% revenue growth, 31-33% gross margin and a credible break-even path; about 1.8-1.9x revenue plus residual net cash.
bull_assumptions: About 20-25% revenue growth, at least 34% gross margin, positive free cash flow and a higher materials and cloud mix; about 3x revenue plus net cash.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a lower price or stronger primary evidence on recurring gross profit, cash conversion and competitive position clears every expected-return, base-return, payoff and margin-of-safety gate after the candidate relationship is accepted; downgrade if consumables attachment, printer share, gross margin, inventory, cash conversion, cloud monetization or use of IPO proceeds deteriorates.
